title: Owl reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Owl body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='26' ry='24' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <!-- Belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='16' ry='15' fill='#D4A574'/>
  <!-- Wing left -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='68' rx='8' ry='18' fill='#6B3F1F' transform='rotate(15 27 68)'/>
  <!-- Wing right -->
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='68' rx='8' ry='18' fill='#6B3F1F' transform='rotate(-15 73 68)'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='24' ry='22' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <!-- Ear tufts -->
  <polygon points='28,22 24,10 36,20' fill='#6B3F1F'/>
  <polygon points='72,22 76,10 64,20' fill='#6B3F1F'/>
  <!-- Face disc left -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='36' rx='13' ry='13' fill='#D4A574'/>
  <!-- Face disc right -->
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='36' rx='13' ry='13' fill='#D4A574'/>
  <!-- Eye left -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='35' r='8' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='35' r='4' fill='#1A1A2E'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='33' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Eye right -->
  <circle cx='60' cy='35' r='8' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='35' r='4' fill='#1A1A2E'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='33' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Beak -->
  <polygon points='47,42 53,42 50,50' fill='#FF8C00'/>
  <!-- Book -->
  <rect x='30' y='74' width='40' height='20' rx='2' fill='#DD3355'/>
  <!-- Book pages -->
  <rect x='34' y='76' width='16' height='16' rx='1' fill='#FFF8DC'/>
  <rect x='50' y='76' width='16' height='16' rx='1' fill='#FFF8DC'/>
  <!-- Book spine -->
  <line x1='50' y1='75' x2='50' y2='93' stroke='#BB2244' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Book page lines left -->
  <line x1='37' y1='80' x2='47' y2='80' stroke='#CCBBAA' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='37' y1='83' x2='47' y2='83' stroke='#CCBBAA' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='37' y1='86' x2='46' y2='86' stroke='#CCBBAA' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- Book page lines right -->
  <line x1='53' y1='80' x2='63' y2='80' stroke='#CCBBAA' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='83' x2='63' y2='83' stroke='#CCBBAA' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='86' x2='62' y2='86' stroke='#CCBBAA' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='91' rx='7' ry='3' fill='#FF8C00'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='91' rx='7' ry='3' fill='#FF8C00'/>
</svg>
